narrative: Trump comments on Russian conduct near the Strait of Hormuz and hawkish Jackson Hole rhetoric keep geopolitical risk and Fed rate expectations in focus — equities firm as S&P 500 gains +0.79%, gold rises +0.23%, DXY consolidates -0.03%, and VIX prints 14.6. USD/JPY holds at 159.34 with the Fed-BoJ +275bp carry differential sustaining bids below intervention territory. Focus turns to the RBNZ rate decision on September 2.
